'''Gelba''' was a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Human/Legends|Human]] from the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Doan]] who represented a [[Mining caste|group]] of [[Mining/Legends|miners]] who rebelled against the [[Doan Royal House]] during the [[Time/Legends|time]] following the [[New Sith Wars]]. In [[980 BBY]] Gelba ordered her forces to force [[Prince/Legends|Prince]] [[Gerran]]'s [[Airspeeder/Legends|airspeeder]] into an emergency landing, however, the prince was accidentally [[Death/Legends|killed]] in the attack. His wife, Princess [[Serra]], became depressed, and her [[Bodyguard/Legends|bodyguard]], [[Lucia (soldier)|Lucia]], found the [[Iktotchi/Legends|Iktotchi]] [[Assassin/Legends|assassin]] [[Darth Cognus|Huntress]] at [[Paradise (space station)|Paradise]] and hired her to assassinate Gelba. The [[Jedi Order/Legends|Jedi Order]], meanwhile, sent [[Jedi Knight/Legends|Jedi Knight]] [[Medd Tandar]] to negotiate with the rebels and Royal Family, as well as to recover [[Dark side of the Force/Legends|dark side]] artifacts that had been dug up on the planet. As Gelba was meeting with Tandar, they were [[Massacre on Doan|attacked]] by the Huntress, who shot and killed Gelba instantly before killing Tandar and the rest of the miners present.
